caseNameFull: Mayor and Board of Aldermen of the City of Natchez v. S. B. McNeely and Mrs. Louisa McNeely, Administratrix and Mrs. Louisa McNeely, Administratrix v. Mayor and Board of Aldermen of the City of Natchez
attorneys: Mr. John B. Brunini for appellants in No. 94 and appellees in No. 108. Messrs. L. T. Kennedy and Hugh Tullis for appellees in No. 94 and appellant in 108.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Affirmed on the authority of Mayor and Board of Aldermen of the Town of Vidalia v. McNeely, Administratrix, and McNeely, Administratrix, v. Mayor and Board of Aldermen of the Town of Vidalia, 274 U. S. 630.
